title: Persuasive or Deceptive Visualization? | Abortion Data
description: This project explores the use of data visualization in the context of abortion data. It examines how visual representations can influence public perception and policy decisions, highlighting the importance of ethical considerations in data presentation.

title: Expository Visualization
description: This project focuses on the creation of expository visualizations that effectively communicate complex data to a general audience. It emphasizes clarity, accuracy, and the use of visual elements to enhance understanding.

title: The Recipe to A Good Rating
description: This project uses linear regression, data visualization, and predictive modeling to analyze the factors that contribute to a good rating for a product or service. It aims to identify key variables and provide actionable insights for improving customer satisfaction.
